Chapter 1403 - 16: Let Me Give It A Try

Chapter 1403: Chapter 16: Let Me Give It a Try

A mere few hundred years have passed.

Lin Yuan’s past self has already fully consolidated.

Not only the past self of the third Origin World’s true self.

The true self of the Chaos Void.

The true self of the first Origin World.

The true self of the second Origin World.

All of them condensed past selves in their own timelines.

"It’s done."

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

With the past self consolidated, it means there are no longer any weaknesses.

Even facing a killing move at the level of a Time Lord, there is the ability to resist.

The Time Lord can travel to the past and kill at an enemy’s weaker stage.

However, the Time Lord in the past timeline is also suppressed.

And the past self inherently exists in the past, not weaker than the present, plus the advantage of home field.

While it may not defeat the Time Lord, self-preservation is not an issue.

"Even after reaching the third realm and becoming a Time Lord, the ’past self’ remains a powerful method."

Lin Yuan mused internally.

The battles at the level of a Time Lord are, in some sense, a contest between past and future.

With the past self anchoring the timeline, fighting alongside another Time Lord of the same level would be much more poised.

"Future self?"

Having condensed the past self, Lin Yuan began thinking about the future self.

The ninth kind of Physical Body Divine Ability he awakened is not complete, it only includes the past self.

There is no future self.

Lin Yuan confirmed the existence of a future self only by deducing and understanding with the past and present as the basis.

But how to condense the future self?

This would require time to attempt.

Unlike the fixed past, the future holds infinite variables.

The difficulty in condensing the future self far exceeds that of the past self.

"The source of my ninth Physical Body Divine Skill should be... the Three-Life Immortal Emperor."

Lin Yuan thought internally.

What is called Physical Body Divine Ability originates from the fundamental power deep within the bloodline.

Since it is a bloodline, a source exists, for instance, the eighth Physical Body Divine Ability "Lord status," which comes from the Lord of Heaven Light.

And the ninth Physical Body Divine Ability "Past Self" should originate from the Three-Life Immortal Emperor.

The Three-Life Immortal Emperor was the first Immortal Emperor of the Great Wilderness Origin World.

It was the Three-Life Immortal Emperor who observed past and future, using the three-life body to penetrate the end of the immortal path, thus discovering that illusory world.

The strength of the Three-Life Immortal Emperor is undoubtedly the strongest among the three Immortal Emperors, and also considered extremely powerful among the Time Lords.

"Unfortunately, after hundreds of years on the immortal path, not to mention seeing the Three-Life Immortal Emperor, I haven’t seen the other two Immortal Emperors either."

Lin Yuan slightly shook his head; if he could meet the Three-Life Immortal Emperor, exchanging insights on reincarnation, with his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, he could definitely speed up the condensation of the "future self".

With the "past self" and "present self", condensing the "future self" is not a hopeless endeavor.

"Take it slow; opportunities will eventually arise."

Lin Yuan was not impatient, as the illusory world at the end of the immortal path contained enough profound mysteries to captivate even a Time Lord, and he would remain in this place for a long timeline.

...

"Only, in the past century, the frequency of tremors in that illusory world has increased significantly."

Lin Yuan looked towards the illusory world at the end of the immortal path, pondering to himself.

In theory, the illusory world shouldn’t appear at the end of the immortal path.

It was locked there by the great means of the three Immortal Emperors, allowing numerous Red Dust Immortals and Immortal Kings to observe and comprehend it.

The so-called immortal path was opened by individual Red Dust Immortals and Immortal Kings aiming to approach the illusory world as closely as possible, observing and understanding more of the essence that emerges from the illusory world.

Since forcibly locking it in, the illusory world naturally struggles.

At intervals, the illusory world roils violently once.

Trying to break free from the lockdown of the three Immortal Emperors.

Much like a big fish originally trapped by a fishing net.

Even if it can’t escape the net, it will roil up numerous undertows around the net.

...

"Currently, there are five immortal paths, each with two or three Immortal Kings and dozens of Red Dust Immortals."

The immortal path Lin Yuan resides in was established by the Reincarnation Immortal King and two other Immortal Kings, along with over sixty Red Dust Immortals.

The other four paths are the same.

The positions these different immortal paths are close to the illusory world vary in distance.

And hence bring different insights.

The Reincarnation Immortal King and the other two Immortal Kings possess considerable strength, and their opened immortal path is very close to the illusory world.

Ranking among the top two of the five immortal paths.

Of course, these five immortal paths were extensions from the original main immortal path.

That main immortal path, the one where Lin Yuan entered via the sealed entrance of the Bronze Immortal Palace.

...

Several days later, Lin Yuan gathered with the Reincarnation Immortal King, Immortal King Bai Bin, and Wushen Immortal King.

"Tianyuan, how goes your understanding?" The Reincarnation Immortal King smiled at Lin Yuan.

The other two Immortal Kings also smiled, with the Wushen Immortal King further offering fine wine and pouring for each.

"It’s been very helpful." Lin Yuan nodded.

The profound essence swirling from the illusory world contains various Origin Daos, an irresistible allure for any being of time.

"When the Three-Life Immortal Emperor first opened the main immortal path, the second Immortal Emperor had not yet been born, and there were only six Immortal Kings." Immortal King Bai Bin remarked nostalgically.

Normally, even with the uniqueness of the Great Wilderness Origin World, producing one Immortal King would already be the limit.

Producing three?

Do they think Immortal Kings are roadside vegetables?

If not for the illusory world, how could one Origin World have three Immortal Kings?

"The Three-Life Immortal Emperor was, indeed, great."

Lin Yuan nodded.

With the Three-Life Immortal Emperor’s methods and power, it could easily dominate the illusory world — why bother opening the main immortal path?
